export_backup_panel.about_2: yalesi sigaba — zonke izitebula ezingeyingxenye ye-FK-downstream graph yezindawo zegunya, kanye nezilungiselelo nama-raster. Ukubuyisela leli bhakede kwesinye isigaba nge-Step 0
export_backup_panel.about_3: ipaneli ikhiqiza isimo esiphelele, kufakwe namamephu ezifunda. Isebenza nge-Horizon; ukukhipha okukhulu (ama-raster aphelele) kuthatha imizuzu engu-20–40.
import_backup_panel.about_2: ikhiphwe kwelinye igamu? Liyayilayisha lapha ukuze uqhubeke. I-backend ihlola uhlobo lwe-schema yamanifestho ngaphambi kokubuyisela — izithombe ezindala ziyenqanwa ngomyalezo ocacile. Ngemuva kokubuyisela okuphumelelayo uzofika esigabeni somhlahlandlela esihambisana nenqubekela elondolweyo (ngakho i-backup ethathwe Esigabeni 3 ikubuyisela Esigabeni 3).
import_backup_panel.picker_note: Amatafula akhona ngempela ku-bundle elayishwe kuphela yilwo abuyiselwayo — amatafula angakhethwa kuleli gamu ayashiywa njengoba ayo.
import_backup_panel.restoring_db: Ukulayisha kuphothulwe — kubuyiselwa idatha-bhase (pg_restore). Kungathatha imizuzu embalwa ku-bundle eliphelele le-rasters.

review_issues_section.aggregation_discre: Ukuhlanganiswa kwezinga lezwe lapho isibalo sabantu sezwe singafani nesixhumano sezibalo zabantwana ngaphezu kuka-5%. Imvamisa lokhu kuwukuhleleka kwe-polygon phakathi kwezinga le-geoBoundaries ADM — akusona isiphutho sohlelo.
review_issues_section.click_source: Chofoza umthombo ukuze ubone imigqa lapho isibalo sabantu siphuma khona:
review_issues_section.click_strategy: Chofoza isu ukuze ubone imigqa exazululwe ngaleyo ndlela:
review_issues_section.empty_state: Ayikho inkinga yezimiso yedatha etholwe. Kulungele ukuqeda ukusetha.
review_issues_section.heading: Ukubuyekezwa kwezimiso yedata
review_issues_section.mark_reviewed_titl: Faka le khadi phansi bese ukumaka njengokubuyekezwe kulesi sikhathi. Ukugcinwa kwakho kuza kuPhase J.
review_issues_section.orphans_why: Imigqa lapho i-parent_id = NULL — i-find_parent_by_spatial ihlele ukuhluleka ngesikhathi sokungenisa, imvamisa ezindawo zezinhlabathi noma lapho izinga laphakathi le-ADM lingekho ku-geoBoundaries (isib. i-Puerto Rico ayinalo i-ADM0/1 row kumthombo). Chofoza noma yimuphi umugqa ngezansi ukuze ubone abazali abakhethwe (spatial-overlap ne-centroid-distance) bese ubhala isinqumo sakho.
review_issues_section.parent_assignment_: Imigqa ngokwesu lokuxazulula umzali. I-'direct' iwuhlobo olujwayelekile (umzali usezingeni elilodwa ephansi, akudingeki ukuba kudlulwe). I-'skip_ancestor' kusho ukuthi izinga lidlulwe (isib. i-CAF level-6 → CAF level-4 ngoba i-level-5 ayikho ye-CAF ku-geoBoundaries). I-'buffered' kusho ukuthi kudingeke ukubekezelela kuka-110m ukuze ama-polygons ahlangane (digitization drift phakathi kwezinga le-ADM eliseduze). Chofoza i-chip ukuze ubone kabanzi. Isibalo sekhanda lekhadi silandela imigqa exazululwe nge-heuristic kuphela ('skip_ancestor' + 'buffered'); i-'direct' inikeza ulwazi kuphela.
review_issues_section.population_assignm: Imigqa lapho isibalo sabantu siphuma khona ku-territory-raster fallback kunokuba siphume ku-raster ye-iso yabo. Imvamisa ama-municipios e-PR ngaphansi kwe-USA, lapho i-raster ye-USA ingakhi i-PR kodwa eye-PRI ikha. I-'primary' kusho ukuthi i-raster ye-iso yomugqa uqobo ihlangane ngqo. Chofoza i-chip yomthombo ukuze ubone kabanzi.
review_issues_section.population_gaps_wh: Izindawo zegunya lapho isibalo sabantu = 0 noma NULL. Iningi liyizindawo zasemakhaya ezingenabantu ezingeni le-ADM elijulile; izinga ezincane (Izwe, Isifunda, Isifunda esincane) zidinga ukubuyekezwa okuseduze — lezi imvamisa zihlobene nomhlaba.
review_issues_section.review_them: Zibuyekeze ngezansi noma uvume uqede ukusetha — izinkinga zinikeza ulwazi, azivimbi.
review_issues_section.sovereign_territor: Imigqa yomhlaba emakiwe nge-iso_code ye-sovereign (isib. USA) enesibalo sabantu=0 ngoba i-WorldPop raster yomhlaba uqobo ayikafakwanga. Ngokufika kwe-territory-raster fallback ye-Phase K, leli bala kufanele lihlelele abe ~0 emva kwe-ETL entsha elandelayo — noma yikuphi okusele kuvela lapha ukuze kuhlolwe.
